title: Placeholder/Slot 模型

data_object_alignment.evidence: 沿用既有 LayoutSlot 数据对象行，不新增或删除需求、任务或对象；通过状态与原因表达来源未提供的值。
data_object_alignment.integration: LayoutTemplate.slots 使用本契约校验每个元素；capacity 使用 TASK-TPL-007 的 CapacityRules，scope.kind=slot；空的 pending collection 仍允许表示尚未完成产品解析。

field_rules.representation: 使用稳定 slot UUIDv4；来源 shapeId 或语义 slot 名只用于 source_ref/原始值，不代替项目槽位身份。
来源声明、明确映射或 unknown；保存原值、规范值和证据引用。
直接/继承几何须同时保存坐标空间、单位和完整边界；未知时坐标必须为空并说明原因。
用开放字符串集合表达来源可支持的内容类别；未证实时保留空集合和 unknown。
仅保存来源明确声明的布尔值；占位符存在本身不推导为必填。
仅保存来源明确声明的布尔值；多个占位符本身不推导为可重复。
引用 contracts/capacity-rules.schema.json；按字符、行、列表项、图片、表格、图表、最小字号和可追溯扩展维度分别记录状态、单位、限值、比较方向与证据；未验证的值为空并说明原因。
保留来源原生属性名和值，并区分直接、继承、部分和未知。
保留来源策略原文；没有显式策略时为 unknown，不预设 shrink、clip 或 reject。

value_status_rules.unknown: value 为空、reason 非空；不得以默认值填充。
value_status_rules.mapped: 保留 source_value、映射 value 和证据；不覆盖来源原值。
value_status_rules.partial: 只承诺记录的来源部分，须写明未覆盖边界。

field_coverage.slot_id: partial: source shapeId is an adapter locator, not a stable cross-run product slot identity; the contract keeps it in source_ref and assigns slot_id separately.
field_coverage.role: partial: manifest maps OOXML placeholder type to semanticRole; mapping is adapter-specific.
field_coverage.bounds: partial: parse_xfrm_record extracts direct geometry and converts EMU to pixels; inherited master geometry is a separate resolution concern. LayoutSlot retains an explicit unit so source-unit conversion is not implicit.
field_coverage.content_types: unknown: the placeholder export does not define a general allowed-content set.
field_coverage.required: unknown: no slot-level required flag in the reviewed placeholder record.
field_coverage.repeatable: unknown: no slot-level repeatability flag in the reviewed placeholder record.
field_coverage.capacity: unknown: no generic capacity contract in the reviewed placeholder record.
field_coverage.style: partial: direct placeholder text style can be extracted; effective inherited style is not established by this field alone.
field_coverage.overflow_policy: unknown: no slot overflow policy in the reviewed placeholder record.

field_coverage.slot_id: unknown: the reviewed template flow does not establish a stable cross-run slot UUID; LayoutSlot identity is separate from raw element identity.
field_coverage.role: partial: semantic components are model-certified from source elements and previews.
field_coverage.bounds: observed in RawSlideLayouts as source positions and sizes.
field_coverage.content_types: partial: template component schemas constrain submitted content, but are not a universal slot content vocabulary.
field_coverage.required: unknown: JSON schema required keys do not establish whether a visual slot is required on every slide.
field_coverage.repeatable: partial: a model pass identifies flexible or repeated regions; this is a certified semantic result, not a raw PPTX field.
field_coverage.capacity: partial: a model pass calculates safe text length and growth constraints; those results depend on analysis and preview.
field_coverage.style: observed in RawSlideLayouts as source styles.
field_coverage.overflow_policy: unknown: the reviewed template flow does not specify a generic slot overflow policy.

field_coverage.slot_id: unknown: LayoutNode.slot is a semantic name, not a stable record UUID; LayoutSlot identity is separate.
field_coverage.role: partial: LayoutNode.slot provides a semantic name for nodes that declare one.
field_coverage.bounds: unknown: the reviewed title node has style but no explicit x/y/width/height bounds.
field_coverage.content_types: unknown: tagName describes a rendered node, not a declared set of allowed content types.
field_coverage.required: unknown: no slot requiredness field in LayoutNode.
field_coverage.repeatable: unknown: no slot repeatability field in LayoutNode.
field_coverage.capacity: unknown: no capacity field in LayoutNode.
field_coverage.style: observed as a string-valued style map on LayoutNode.
field_coverage.overflow_policy: unknown: no overflow policy field in LayoutNode.

coverage: Static source crosswalk across PPT Master, Presenton and ai-agent-ppt, plus typed fixture based on the pinned real PPTX layout sample.
limits: The three repositories expose different abstraction layers; shared field names do not imply equivalent runtime behavior.
Source code was reviewed but the three source applications were not executed against the real PPTX sample.
The real sample has no slide parts, so it does not establish slide-level requiredness, repeated content, capacity or overflow behavior.
No YoloongPPT slot parser/runtime or Office rendering is implemented by this contract task.

TASK-TPL-007 CapacityRules contract is defined and integrated, but the current source fixtures contain no measured capacity thresholds or minimum font sizes; runtime measurement and evaluation remain open.
